run_pipeline: run iterative restrained Amber minimization on a protein structure to resolve structural violations
clean_protein: clean a protein structure by adding missing atoms and fixing PDB issues
find_violations: find structural violations in a protein including clashing atoms and bond length issues
get_violation_metrics: compute violation and alignment metrics for a protein structure including per-residue violations
make_atom14_positions: construct denser 14-atom positions from a protein's 37-atom representation for analysis
